+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import boto3
+
+
+def _client():
+    return boto3.client(
+        "s3",
+        aws_access_key_id=os.environ.get("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"),
+        aws_secret_access_key=os.environ.get("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"),
+        aws_session_token=os.environ.get("AWS_SESSION_TOKEN"),
+        region_name=os.environ.get("AWS_REGION") or os.environ.get("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION"),
+    )
+
+
+def list_prefix(bucket: str, prefix: str = "", delimiter: Optional[str] = None, max_keys: Optional[int] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    params: Dict[str, Any] = {"Bucket": bucket, "Prefix": prefix}
+    if delimiter is not None:
+        params["Delimiter"] = delimiter
+    if max_keys is not None:
+        params["MaxKeys"] = max_keys
+
+    response = _client().list_objects_v2(**params)
+    contents: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for item in response.get("Contents", []):
+        contents.append(
+            {
+                "key": item.get("Key"),
+                "size": item.get("Size"),
+                "last_modified": item.get("LastModified").isoformat() if item.get("LastModified") else None,
+                "etag": item.get("ETag"),
+                "storage_class": item.get("StorageClass"),
+            }
+        )
+
+    return {
+        "bucket": bucket,
+        "prefix": prefix,
+        "is_truncated": response.get("IsTruncated", False),
+        "next_continuation_token": response.get("NextContinuationToken"),
+        "keys": contents,
+        "common_prefixes": [p.get("Prefix") for p in response.get("CommonPrefixes", [])],
+    }
+
+
+__all__ = ["list_prefix"]
*** End Patch

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from typing import Optional
+
+import boto3
+
+
+@dataclass
+class PresignedDownloadResult:
+    bucket: str
+    key: str
+    url: str
+    expires_in: int
+    expires_at: datetime
+
+
+def _client():
+    return boto3.client(
+        "s3",
+        aws_access_key_id=os.getenv("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"),
+        aws_secret_access_key=os.getenv("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"),
+        aws_session_token=os.getenv("AWS_SESSION_TOKEN"),
+        region_name=os.getenv("AWS_REGION") or os.getenv("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION"),
+    )
+
+
+def create_presigned_download_url(
+    bucket: str,
+    key: str,
+    expires_in: int = 3600,
+    version_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    response_content_disposition: Optional[str] = None,
+    response_content_type: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> PresignedDownloadResult:
+    params = {"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key}
+    if version_id:
+        params["VersionId"] = version_id
+    if response_content_disposition:
+        params["ResponseContentDisposition"] = response_content_disposition
+    if response_content_type:
+        params["ResponseContentType"] = response_content_type
+    url = _client().generate_presigned_url(
+        ClientMethod="get_object",
+        Params=params,
+        ExpiresIn=expires_in,
+    )
+    expires_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(seconds=expires_in)
+    return PresignedDownloadResult(bucket=bucket, key=key, url=url, expires_in=expires_in, expires_at=expires_at)
*** End Patch
